The Birthday Balloon Maker is a production building unlocked at experience level 17. It was delivered by Alfred the Mailman on June 11, 2024.

On 10th June 2025, Alfred delivered the machine again, this time including more products. The postman did it again on 19th June 2026.

It does not need to be repaired or bought. It is given for free.

It is used to make various types of balloons.

Appearance

Birthday Balloon Maker looks like a big cart with a lever and an air pump on top with a variety of balloons tied around it. The remaining two are tied on the wheel. Next to it is a roll of red string and a scissor.

The mastered version gains various golden parts and a star on the wheel.

Upgrading

Main article: Production Buildings

The birthday balloon maker originally has two slots available. Unlocking more slots costs diamonds:

  • 3rd slot: 24 diamonds
  • 4th slot: 36 diamonds
  • 5th slot: 48 diamonds
  • 6th slot: 60 diamonds
  • 7th slot: 72 diamonds
  • 8th slot: 85 diamonds
  • 9th slot: 100 diamonds
